metadata.mi_ranking_note: Mutual Information scores computed by sklearn.feature_selection.mutual_info_classif on the training split (60% of data, seed=42).
metadata.mrmr_note: mRMR top-k uses a greedy MID variant: at each step the feature maximising MI(f,y) − mean MI(f,S) is selected, where S is the set of already-selected features.

top_3_mi.description: Top-3 features by Mutual Information (computed on training split, seed=42).

corr_filtered_08.description: Correlation-filtered at |r|>0.8. Within each high-corr pair the feature with lower MI is dropped.

corr_filtered_095.description: Correlation-filtered at |r|>0.95. Within each high-corr pair the feature with lower MI is dropped.
